snippet.title: BLOK - Official Demo Trailer (Polish) | Available Now on Steam & GOG
snippet.description:
I’m happy to announce that the BLOK demo is now live!

The demo lets you feel the atmosphere and nostalgia, and introduces the dark mystery behind the story.

If you enjoy the demo, add BLOK to your wishlist
STEAM https://store.steampowered.com/app/3813870/BLOK
GOG https://www.gog.com/pl/game/blok

Join BLOK on discord:
https://discord.gg/xYzNbHptkR

Trailer production:
Remake Production |
www.remake.mov
Direction: Kacper Król @ToJestKacpi 
Audio: Mike Johnson @MikeJohnsonBeats 

Thank you for your support guys!

Cheers!
Pyotr
